name: Cheech & Chong - 6 Pack x 0.5g Cryo Infused Pre-Rolls - Banana OG
description:
Six joints, extra kick. The Cheech & Chong Banana OG 6-pack gives you six half-gram pre-rolls — 3 grams total — each packed with quality flower and cryo-infused with distillate for a bolder, more potent smoke. Perfectly portioned for shorter sessions, sharing, or keeping a few on hand.

Banana OG brings sweet tropical fruit together with classic OG backbone: ripe, creamy banana up front, grounded by earthy pine and a smooth, gassy finish. It's a rich, full-bodied flavor made for easy sessions with an extra step up in strength.

Why you'll love it:

6 × 0.5G cryo-infused pre-rolls — 3 grams total, quality flower infused with distillate for extra potency
Perfectly portioned — right-sized for a quick session or passing around
Cryo-infusion process — locks in flavor and delivers a smooth, even burn
Signature Banana OG flavor — sweet, creamy banana with earthy, gassy OG notes
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in every pack. Cheech & Chong Banana OG is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
